# Brodie character kit

> Mascot kit for Brodie, a chibi gym-buddy character. Body colour #EFE7DA (cream, never pink). Black BRODIE tank top. Flat sticker style.

- [Spec (JSON)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/seraphimlabs-dev/brodie-character-kit/main/brodie.json): colours, locked traits, costume slots, canon image prompt, QA thresholds
- [Agent instructions](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/seraphimlabs-dev/brodie-character-kit/main/AGENTS.md)
- [Reference: flex](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/seraphimlabs-dev/brodie-character-kit/main/reference/brodie-flex.png)
- [Reference: sit and wave](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/seraphimlabs-dev/brodie-character-kit/main/reference/brodie-sit-wave.png)
- [Profile picture](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/seraphimlabs-dev/brodie-character-kit/main/pfp/brodie-pfp.png)
- [Colour checker](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/seraphimlabs-dev/brodie-character-kit/main/tools/check_cream.py)
